name: AI Task Planning Skill
shortDescription: Break a vague business goal into scoped tasks, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
longDescription: A planning skill for turning solo-operator goals into executable task files, dependency maps, and verification steps before implementation starts.
problemSolved: Solo founders often start building before the scope, dependencies, and verification gates are clear.
notFor: urgent manual fixes with no planning value
humanApprovalBoundary: The user or Chat Agent approves execution batches before implementation.
safeTestModeRecommendation: Run on a sample blueprint before using it on production code.
implementationSteps: Write the user request into a planning brief.
Break the work into small task files.
examplePrompt: Convert this blueprint into executable task files with dependencies, acceptance criteria, testing requirements, and QA requirements.
exampleOutput: TASK-001: Create data schema; TASK-002: Create seed content; dependency-map.md; blockers.md
whyUseThis: It keeps one-person projects moving without constant interruption
whenNotToUse: When the task is obvious and reversible
When the user only needs a short answer
cheaperAlternative: A manual checklist in a markdown file.
saferAlternative: Require Chat Agent review before any task moves to implementation.

name: AI Research Collector Skill
shortDescription: Collect verified research into structured findings, assumptions, recommendations, and sources.

whenNotToUse: When research requires paid/private access you do not have
When a source cannot be verified
saferAlternative: Require source links for every claim used in public copy.

name: AI Writer Skill
shortDescription: Draft practical content that explains decisions, workflows, and implementation steps.

problemSolved: Solo founders need publishing velocity without turning pages into shallow AI filler.

name: AI QA Review Skill
shortDescription: Check content or implementation against requirements, blueprint, SEO, safety, and monetization rules.
longDescription: A QA skill for catching thin content, unsupported claims, missing disclosure, missing progress updates, and blueprint drift before a task is accepted.
problemSolved: Solo projects often ship work without a second reviewer.
humanApprovalBoundary: Chat Agent decides final acceptance after QA.

examplePrompt: Review this task result for blueprint alignment, SEO completeness, disclosure, progress update requirement, and unsupported claims.
exampleOutput: PASS with notes, or FAIL with required fixes.

whenNotToUse: When there is no task definition
When specialized legal/security review is required
